rows.ARS:
Apricot or apricot blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MACamster
Exhibition name: Top Notch ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1990).
Introduced in New Zealand by McGredy Roses International (New Zealand) in 1998.
Introduced in United Kingdom by C & K Jones in 2002 as 'Simply the Best'.
rows.Bloom: Apricot or apricot blend. Golden-apricot. Bronze. Strong, fruity, musk fragrance. 26 to 40 petals. Average diameter 4.25". Small to medium bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Large, medium green foliage.

Height: 35" to 4'7" (90 to 140cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to blackspot . Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Breeder's notes: Matawhero Magic - Macamster. For the Gisborne winery.
